title: Frequently Asked Questions, Google UCP Guide
notes: Read 2026-10-20 (page last updated 2026-10-16) and again 2026-11-14 through the .md twin (last updated 2026-11-03 UTC; the 2026-10-30 version differed only by an MCP question). Still says: merchant is MoR, PSP must process Google tokens, PAN_ONLY, Google-UCP-Prober/1.0 health checks, order data retained until the user requests deletion. Changed between 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-30: checkout requests carry UCP-Agent and a User-Agent of Google-Shopping-Merchant-Integration, Google/UCP* or Google-UCP-Prober/1.0; discovery and OAuth client_credentials requests carry no UCP-Agent; Account Linking uses OpenAuth or Google-AccountLinking-Fetcher/1.0; headers alone must not authenticate. Verification methods are now mutual TLS against Google's UCP Root CAs, ES256 RFC 9421 signatures checked against the keys at https://ucp.goog/.well-known/ucp.json (24-hour cache, refetch on an unknown kid) and source-ASN rules (AS15169; AS396982 for Account Linking). The earlier wording (the User-Agent begins with Google/UCP; verify by reverse DNS or published IP range files) has been replaced.

title: Exponential: Shopify's Fall '26 Edition
notes: Read 2026-11-14 (HTTP 200; datePublished 2026-10-28T14:35:30Z). Shop Pay checkout inside personal AI agents, starting with Muse from Meta, Claude Duet and Instinct; Claude Duet, Grok Bot and Instinct also offer Shop Pay for brands not on Shopify; for agent purchases from merchants off Shopify, Shop Pay uses tokens from Mastercard, Visa and Discover, with American Express coming soon, and the card is never shared with the agent; shop.md shopping skill; Universal Checkout on Shop; a knowledge base page at Sales channels > Agentic for the facts agents get. Names no network program and none of the eight protocols.

title: Introducing Personal Agent Protocol
notes: Read 2026-11-14 (HTTP 200). Announces Personal Agent Protocol, an open standard that Meta and Sierra are developing with Genesys, Instinct, Rocket, Shopify, Stripe and Walmart for how personal agents interact with businesses. No mention of ACP.

title: Releasing Personal Agent Protocol 1.0
notes: Read 2026-11-14 (HTTP 200). Version 1.0 of Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy). Shopify has enabled Poppy for every merchant, and every Shopify store automatically publishes a Poppy file; UCP handles the shopping (finding products, filling a cart, checking out) and Poppy what happens before it (who the agent is and what it may do); Shopify co-authored the commerce extension that links the two and connects to UCP Ask; Meta's Muse looks for Poppy first on every site; more than 100 design partners. No mention of ACP.

title: Visa USA Interchange Reimbursement Fees (2026-10-24 edition)
notes: Read 2026-11-14 (HTTP 200, 502,917 bytes, Last-Modified 2026-10-29, 30 pages, footer dated 2026-10-24, Visa Public). Like the 2026-04-18 edition read on 2026-10-19, the text never mentions agents, agentic transactions or Visa Intelligent Commerce, so it has no agentic interchange category.

title: Get In, Decide, Prove: A Merchant-Side Readiness Benchmark for Agentic Commerce (arXiv 2610.17378)
publisher: arXiv (Adrian de Valois-Franklin, Alex Bogdan, Anas Ibrahim, Ibrahim Shaer, Tamaz Andguladze)
notes: Preprint, not peer reviewed (v1, 2026-10-12; read through the HTML version). Pilot access census of 555 merchant sites that two payment processors publicly name as clients, run on 2026-09-30 between 11:38 and 12:07 UTC: of the 429 sites where /.well-known/ucp could be observed, 28 (6.5%) published a UCP business profile, 24 of them retail and 21 referencing storefronts on a single hosted commerce platform; the authors call such files weak signs of readiness.

title: Personal Agent Protocol documentation index (llms.txt)
notes: Read 2026-11-14 (HTTP 200). The docs are version 1.0; drafts 0.1 (2026-10-09), 0.2 (2026-10-24), 0.3 (2026-11-04) and 0.4 (2026-11-10) are frozen. Extensions: Browser Control, Disclosures, Links, Mediated Sign-In, Operations and UCP, in which Poppy finds the company and signs the user in and the shopping happens through UCP. Discovery at /.well-known/poppy.json; the 1.0 specification recommends Web Bot Auth (RFC 9421) signatures. No extension or mention for ACP.
